tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `ground`, `surface` and every tint (15.9:1 on ground); text on `sun`, `mint`, `lilac` and `coral` fills (6.1:1 or better). Also the fill of dark bands, status pages and the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, helper copy, timestamps, inactive tab labels. Reads on `ground` (8.1:1), `surface` (8.8:1) and `lilac-tint` (7.4:1). Not for text on `ink`.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App page background behind cards and sidebar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, header, tab bar. Also text and the pill CTA on `ink` bands (17.3:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline card and divider borders. Decorative only (1.3:1 on surface): never the sole edge of an input or control — pair controls with `ink-muted` borders or a fill.

tokens.name: band-eyebrow
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels and muted copy on `ink` bands (10.9:1). Never on light grounds.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: BetterPoints: the BP chip, point totals, earned-points highlights. Highest salience — at most one sun element per view region. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Positive and helping states: Tolong, confirmed bookings, verified check-ins, success. Text on it is `ink`; always pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: The township line, map areas and soft interaction states. 1.8:1 on surface, so the line is decorative — meaning on it is carried by `ink` stations and labels. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Primary action and attention: main buttons, the active township-line station, notification count. Text on it is `ink` (6.1:1), never white (2.8:1). Never coral text on light grounds; coral text on `ink` is fine (6.1:1).

tokens.name: sun-tint
tokens.usage: Soft BetterPoints backgrounds: points-earned rows, reward highlights. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: mint-tint
tokens.usage: Soft success and help-request backgrounds. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: lilac-tint
tokens.usage: Active navigation: the selected sidebar row and mobile tab. Hover and selected rows. Text on it is `ink` or `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: coral-tint
tokens.usage: Soft attention backgrounds: pending actions, to-dos needing a response. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid outline with a 2px offset on every interactive element. 13.7:1 or better on every light ground; on `ink` bands use `surface` instead.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `sun`, `mint`, `lilac` and `coral` fills.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero and status-page headlines. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles: Home greeting, Borrow, Events, Impact, admin pages.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles: items, events, rewards, poster overlays.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Borrow it for the weekend and return it Sunday.
styles.usage: Default reading text; never below 16px on mobile for long copy.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card metadata, helper text, table cells.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows above headings and on bands.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: BetterPoints, metrics and counts. Always with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps inside cards, list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards in a grid; band padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Band padding on desktop; status-page vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips, badge icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons that are not pills, list rows, tab highlight.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and posters.

tokens.name: radius-band
tokens.usage: Bottom corners of hero and dark bands.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill CTAs, BP chip, notification count.

tokens.usage: Resting cards, together with a `border` hairline.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered or focused interactive cards, the mobile tab bar.
